up: Retrieve distinct rows containing IC50 values in nM for compounds tested against the target 'Prostaglandin D2 receptor 2' (CHEMBL5071). For each result, include: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, assay_description, activity_details (standard_value, standard_units, standard_relation), target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Filter for activities where standard_type is IC50 and standard_units is nM. Join with docs to get pubmed_id or doi (use pubmed_id if available, else doi), but do not filter on doc_type. Ensure canonical_smiles is not null.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  act.standard_value AS standard_value,
  act.standard_units AS standard_units,
  act.standard_relation AS standard_relation,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism,
  COALESCE(CAST(docs.pubmed_id AS TEXT), docs.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi
FROM activities act
JOIN assays ass ON act.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON act.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN docs ON act.doc_id = docs.doc_id
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5071'
  AND act.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND LOWER(act.standard_units) = 'nm'
  AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
  AND (docs.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR docs.doi IS NOT NULL)
